Class LessonsManualTestProcedures

java.lang.Object
testingAutomation.LessonsManualTestProcedures
public class LessonsManualTestProcedures extends Object

Title: LessonsManualTestProcedures Class.

Description: The manual tests for the Contributor user stories. They cover what the semi-automated suites cannot: what a window shows and how it responds to a person. The suites prove the decisions are right (LessonsModelTestingAutomation checks every decision the three lesson Models make); these procedures prove the windows act on those decisions.

Running this class prints each procedure in turn and asks the tester to type P (passed), F (failed), or S (skipped) after carrying it out in the running application. The totals are printed at the end, in the same Pass/Failure style as the other suites, so a manual run can be shown in the TestingScreencast next to the automated ones. When no console input is available, the procedures are printed and every one is counted as skipped.

Set up before the first procedure: start FoundationsMain with an empty database, create the admin account, then invite and create two Role1 accounts, "contribA" and "contribB". MAN-01 to MAN-07 must be run in order, because later procedures use the lessons earlier ones create.

Each procedure is one method whose Javadoc gives the requirement, the steps, and the expected result. The steps the method prints are the same text.

    • man01EmptyListMessage

      private static void man01EmptyListMessage()

      MAN-01 (CS-2, negative). An empty list is explained in words on screen.

      Steps: log in as contribA; press Lessons Learned.

      Expected: the list is empty and the status line under it reads "No lessons have been recorded yet. Press New Lesson to record the first one."

    • man02CreateSetsContributor

      private static void man02CreateSetsContributor()

      MAN-02 (CS-1, positive). A lesson is created from the editor, and the contributor is taken from the login rather than typed.

      Steps: press New Lesson; check the page shows "Contributor: contribA" as a label with no text field for it; enter title "H2 file lock", category "Database", description "Only one process can open the file."; press Save Lesson.

      Expected: the list shows the new lesson at the top, "(by contribA)", and the status line reads "Showing 1 of 1 lesson."

    • man03RefusedFieldIsNamed

      private static void man03RefusedFieldIsNamed()

      MAN-03 (CS-10, negative). A refused field is named in an alert and nothing is saved.

      Steps: press New Lesson; leave Title empty, fill Category and Description; press Save Lesson.

      Expected: a "Please Check Your Input" alert headed "The title is required" appears; after closing it the editor still shows the typed values; after Cancel the list still shows 1 lesson.

    • man04DeleteAsksFirst

      private static void man04DeleteAsksFirst()

      MAN-04 (CS-8, positive and negative). Delete asks for confirmation, Cancel keeps the lesson, and OK removes it.

      Steps: create a second lesson "Delete me"; open it; press Delete Lesson; press Cancel in the dialog; press Delete Lesson again; press OK.

      Expected: a dialog headed "Delete lesson #n?" appears both times; after Cancel the lesson is still shown; after OK an information dialog reads "It has been removed from the list for everyone." and the list no longer holds "Delete me".

    • man05OtherUserCannotChange

      private static void man05OtherUserCannotChange()

      MAN-05 (CS-9, negative). Another user can read a lesson but cannot edit or delete it, and the page says why.

      Steps: log out; log in as contribB; press Lessons Learned; open "H2 file lock".

      Expected: every field is shown; Edit Lesson and Delete Lesson are disabled; the note reads "This lesson was contributed by contribA. Only they can edit or delete it."

    • man06DeleteSeenByOtherUser

      private static void man06DeleteSeenByOtherUser()

      MAN-06 (CS-8, positive). A deletion by one user is seen by every other user.

      Steps: still as contribB, return to the list and search "Delete me".

      Expected: no lesson is shown and the status line reads "No lessons match "Delete me". Press Show All to see every lesson."

    • man07RestartKeepsLessons

      private static void man07RestartKeepsLessons()

      MAN-07 (CS-12, positive). Lessons survive quitting and restarting the application.

      Steps: press Quit; start FoundationsMain again; log in as contribA; press Lessons Learned; open "H2 file lock".

      Expected: the lesson is listed and opens with the title, category, description, contributor, and creation date entered in MAN-02.

    • procedure

      private static void procedure(String label, String steps, String expected)

      Method: procedure

      Description: Prints one procedure and records the tester's answer. Anything other than P or F, including no answer, counts as skipped, so a procedure is only counted as passed when the tester said so.

      Parameters:
      label - the procedure id, what it checks, and the requirement
      steps - what the tester does
      expected - what the tester should see
